title: Require API Service Contract Property Descriptions
forbids: a directly authored TypeBox object property in an API-plugin service module contract without a nonblank static description
why: API-plugin interiors instantiate the same service contract law as standalone services, while retaining their own bounded Habitat application root.
remediate: Use the imported canonical Type binding directly, without import or local aliases. Add a truthful nonblank single- or double-quoted description under the unquoted description key, delegate the property to a named *Schema authority, or spread a named *Schema.properties authority.
message: Directly authored API-service contract properties must declare their semantic meaning.
